typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		RunLoadDate as timestamp,
		SourceCode as string,
		EndTime as timestamp,
		EventMessage as string,
		PackageName as string,
		TaskName as string,
		SSISBatchId as integer,
		BatchId as long,
		StartTime as timestamp,
		Event as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from ( SELECT *   FROM [Temp].[LoadSummary1]   union     SELECT *   FROM [Temp].[LoadSummary2]   UNION   SELECT *   FROM [Temp].[LoadSummary3]   UNION   SELECT *   FROM [Temp].[LoadSummary4]   UNION   SELECT *   FROM [Temp].[LoadSummary5]   UNION   SELECT *   FROM [Temp].[LoadSummary6]      UNION   SELECT *   FROM [Temp].[LoadSummary7]     UNION   SELECT *   FROM [Temp].[LoadSummary8]     UNION   SELECT *   FROM [Temp].[LoadSummary9]     UNION   SELECT *   FROM [Temp].[LoadSummary10]   )a',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCControlsummarytemps
SRCControlsummarytemps sink(input(
		RunLoadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SourceCode as string,
		EndTime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EventMessage as string,
		PackageName as string,
		TaskName as string,
		SSISBatchId as integer,
		BatchId as long,
		StartTime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Event as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		RunLoadDate,
		SourceCode,
		EndTime,
		EventMessage,
		PackageName,
		TaskName,
		SSISBatchId,
		BatchId,
		StartTime,
		Event)) ~> DSTControlSummary
